units: Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 12 המתבייש מן הי׳ who is put to shame by a person of high dignity (opp. פגום).—Pl. יְקָרִים, יְקָרִין.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 100b:3">B. Bath. 100ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 23b:9">Meg. 23ᵇ</cite> (address to mourners) <he>עמדו י׳ עמודו וכ׳</he> stand up, dear friends, stand up &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 44a:2">Men. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>דמיו י׳</he> its price is high; a. fr.—
Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 2 היְקָרִין R. S. to Kel. III, 5 (ed. היקירן, הייקרין) the heavy earthen vessels used for boiling pitch.—Fem. יְקָרָה, pl. יְקָרוֹת.
<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:13">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 43a:10">Snh. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>נשים י׳ וכ׳</he> worthy women in Jerusalem.—V. <cite ref="J00574"><he>יַקִּיר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:2">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 12:27">Prov. XII, 27</cite>) <he>כדי … שהוא יְקָרוֹ של עולם וכ׳</he> in order that Jacob might come who is the choice of the world &c.; <cite ref="Proverbs 12:27">ib.</cite> <he>שאינם נוטלים מן יְקָרָם שלעתיד לכוא וכ׳</he> that they shall receive in this world nothing of their prize reserved for the hereafter; Yalk. ib. 115, v. <cite ref="H01749"><he>חָרַץ</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="J00586"><he>יְקָרוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Proverbs 12:27">Ib.</cite> <he>כדי … ויטול את הברכות שהן י׳ של עולם חרוצות לו</he> in order that Jacob might come and take the blessings, which are the choice of the world, decreed to him (Gen. R. l. c. <he>שמעיקר העולם חרוצות לו</he>).
